objective: Redesign configuration panels inside each React Flow node according to the mockup design covering 11 node types across Trigger, Condition, Config, and Action categories.

acceptance.criterion: Trigger Sensor inspector renders probe selector, filter pills, read interval with suffix, and disconnect auto-stop toggle.
Trigger FSM inspector renders machine selector, trigger stage pills, and minimum duration input.
Trigger Cron inspector renders preset schedule, cron expression, timezone selector, catch-up and offline toggles.
Trigger Webhook inspector renders endpoint with copy button, mode selector, auth selector, and payload sample tags.
Condition Single inspector renders comparison variable, operator selector, threshold with unit, application window, and debounce toggle.
Condition Group inspector renders group operator segmented control, removable child condition chips, add condition button, and NOT toggle.
Action Chain inspector renders next flow selector, delay with unit suffix, pass context toggle, and loop iteration limit.
Action Dose/Water inspector renders pump selector, volume ml, PWM power percentage, and safety limit toggle.
Action Alert inspector renders severity level segmented control, channel pills, message template textarea, and cooldown duration.
Config Read inspector renders config key selector, target device group selector, store-in variable input, and safe access notice.
Config Overwrite inspector renders config key, override value with unit, execution condition, safety rollback toggle, and restore mode selector.
